intent: Keep the reviewed diff limits cited to the code that now holds them, after the version diff and the suggestion preview moved their 1 MiB cap, context lines and NUL sniff into one shared source.
observable_outcome: A version diff still stops at 1 MiB per file, a suggestion target over 1 MiB or with a NUL byte in its first 8000 bytes still gets no diff.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The three diff limits behave as before at and one past their bounds.
